_meta.source: Pensieve starter goals (installed build). Generic on purpose; rename or replace them in More > Set goals.
_meta.lane_mapping_rationale: Lane colors follow goal order: crimson=Goal1, gold=Goal2, emerald=Goal3, azure=Goal4. Colors are cosmetic.
_meta.note: Edit these in the dashboard (More > Set goals). Pensieve uses them to sort your tasks into Houses and to explain why each task matters.

goals.name: Career and work
goals.summary: Do work I am proud of, keep my commitments to my team, and keep growing my skills and my career.
success_criteria: Deliver what I commit to, on time
Learn at least one new skill this quarter
Keep a running record of wins for reviews
goals.impact_statement: Steady, visible progress at work that compounds into bigger opportunities.

goals.name: Home and family
goals.summary: Keep home life running smoothly and make time for the people who matter most.
success_criteria: Bills, chores and appointments handled before they become urgent
Regular time with family and friends
goals.impact_statement: Less background stress and more time for what matters.

goals.name: Health and wellbeing
goals.summary: Look after my body and mind: movement, sleep, check-ups, and rest.
goals.impact_statement: Energy and focus for everything else.

goals.name: Learning and side projects
goals.summary: Make room for curiosity: courses, books, hobbies, and things I am building on the side.
success_criteria: Finish one course or book a month
Ship one side project milestone a quarter
goals.impact_statement: Keeps me growing outside of the day job.
